# Krillion Knowledge Base & Daily Answers (LLMs.txt)
> Project: Krillion Hub & Krillion Unlimited
> Website: https://krilliongame.org/
> Updated: 2026-10-10

## Overview
Krillion (also referred to as "The Daily Dive") is a browser-based daily reverse-trivia word game.
Players receive 7 daily prompts with a 25-second countdown per prompt.
Unlike traditional trivia games that reward common popular answers, Krillion awards maximum points (up to 100 per prompt, 700 total, representing depth down to 7,000 meters in the ocean trench) for the rarest valid answers.

## Scoring Tiers
- Plankton (4–10 pts): The most common, obvious answers (e.g., Los Angeles for a California city).
- Too Clever (8–15 pts): Overthought answers where many players collide trying to sound smart (e.g., Sacramento, Pasadena).
- Schooler (16–30 pts): Mid-tier answers.
- Rare (32–60 pts): Answers selected by only a minority of players.
- Deep Cut (64–85 pts): High-tier obscure knowledge.
- One in a Krillion (100 pts): The rarest legitimate answer that hits maximum ocean depth.
